hint.click: Click on the map or search a place to add a stop to the selected day. Drag the number to reorder stops, the colored dot to reorder days.
error.geocode: Search service unreachable, try again shortly.
dialog.copyError: Copy failed: select the text and copy it manually.
export.title: Export as text
export.help: Paste it in a comment or save it as a file. Import it back with "Import text".
import.title: Import from text
import.help: Paste a trip (one "## ..." line per day, one numbered line per stop) or load a .txt file. Stops without coordinates are searched by name: add the city for better results.
import.empty: No stops found in the text.
import.summary: {count} of {total} stops ready to import. Check the places found.
share.title: Share link
share.help: The trip is stored in the link itself: whoever opens it can import it, no account needed.
share.received: Someone shared a trip with you: check it and import it.
share.invalid: The share link is invalid or incomplete.
stop.copied: Copied: paste it in a day's text editor (✎).
textEdit.help: One stop per line: "09:00 Place name". Numbers and order are fixed automatically; stops without coordinates are searched near the trip.
textEdit.placeholder:
1. 09:00 Upper Barrakka Gardens
2. Fort St Elmo
textEdit.notFound: Not found: {names}. Fix the name (add the city) or remove the line.
image.title: Export image
image.helpAll: Image with map and stop list for all days. For a single day, select it on the map first.
image.helpDay: Image with map and stop list of the day selected on the map.
storage.notice: Trips are saved only in this browser, and some (Safari on iPhone) delete data of sites not opened for a few days. Install the app on the Home screen or export the text to keep a copy.
install.title: Install the app on your device
install.intro: Once installed, Follow me opens from the Home screen like an app, works offline too, and the browser will not delete your trips for inactivity.
install.steps.ios:
Tap the Share button (the square with an up arrow).
Scroll and tap "Add to Home Screen".
Confirm with "Add".
install.steps.android:
Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
Confirm.
install.steps.desktop:
Chrome or Edge: click the install icon on the right of the address bar, or choose "Install" from the menu.
Safari on Mac: File menu > "Add to Dock".
Firefox does not install web apps: you can bookmark the page.
install.iosNote: Since iOS 16.4 it also works from Chrome and Edge, via their Share menu; before only from Safari.
trip.startDate: Date of the first day (optional): the others follow in order
